_provenance.notes: The North Pacific Observer Program (NPOP) monitors bycatch in groundfish fisheries. Prohibited Species Catch (PSC) limits are set annually to protect salmon, halibut, herring, and crab. PSC bycatch of Chinook salmon in the pollock trawl fishery is particularly contentious — it has been implicated as a contributor to Yukon and Kuskokwim Chinook declines.
